empty.title: Choose a warehouse to work in
empty.description: You belong to {{count}} warehouses. Nothing is chosen for you when there is more than one, so your next action always applies to the site you meant.

selectionEnded.title: {{name}} is no longer available to you
selectionEnded.description: It was archived, so nothing is selected now. Your access to the other warehouses is unchanged.

unavailable.title: No warehouse is available to you
unavailable.description: You do not belong to any warehouse that can be worked in right now. Ask a workspace administrator for access.

contextSwitcher.workspaceNoAccessExplanation: You do not have access to the workspace.

noContext.heading: Nothing is entered yet
noContext.description: The context switcher lists the workspace and any warehouses you can enter.

entryRefusal.heading: This address isn't available to you
entryRefusal.description: Use the switcher to go somewhere you have access to.

archivedEntryRefusal.heading: This warehouse is archived
archivedEntryRefusal.description: Archived warehouses aren't administered here. What one already holds stays readable to everyone permitted to read it.

archivedWarehouse.heading: This warehouse has been archived
archivedWarehouse.description: Its demand, drafts and items stay readable to everyone whose role carried the watch permission before archiving, on exactly the same terms. Nothing that changes what it holds is authorized any more.

landing.errorDescription: We couldn't check your access. Try again.
